ScienceWorld: Is your Agent Smarter than a 5th Grader? (2203.07540v1) · paper method: The study reports all agent results using easy-mode simplifications and provides gold trajectories from thirty hand-coded oracle agents representing canonical solution methods.

Permanent record ID: cohort4.claim.scienceworld.oracle-and-easy-mode
